cohort: 192 mothers of premature infants born between 24 + 0-35 + 6 weeks gestation
finding: Human milk macronutrient concentrations after preterm delivery are associated with pre-pregnancy obesity, parity, mode of delivery, and smoking.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was associated with increased carbohydrate content in colostrum, and mode of delivery possibly influenced protein and carbohydrate levels in mature milk.
